name: Popzuno
subtitle: Swipe. Match. Unleash.
shortDescription: Match faces and chase records in five offline modes. Optional personal photos.
description:
Swap neighboring blocks, make matches and unleash your powers at the right moment. Popzuno offers five ways to chase your next personal best.

Survive a rising board in Rush. Earn more seconds by matching in Time Rush. Complete stage goals in Ascend. Take on the same UTC-day opening in Daily 90. Relax: no timer or rising rows; the board refills after moves. Play at your pace with calm music.

A square earns Bomb. A horizontal four earns Rocket, vertical four Shuffle, an L/T intersection Cross and a straight five Nova. Build chains and activate Overdrive for stronger multipliers.

Download, all five modes, standard photos and powers are free. Premium contains cosmetics only, with no subscription or winning advantage. Apple/Google handle payment details; we do not receive card data. Entitlements come from verified store transactions. Restore is available; refunds/revocations remove access when updated store information arrives. Transaction records may be stored locally. The base game works offline. Google AdMob and UMP are contacted only when a player in the adult age band asks to prepare optional ads in Settings. Ads are never compulsory. Personalization and advertising-ID access are disabled. The ad provider may process IP address, device/app/network information, diagnostics, performance and ad interactions. Photos, face measurements and character names are not passed to ad SDKs. Manage ad privacy choices in Settings.

Circuit Bloom adapts to gameplay speed, with separate effects and haptics on supported devices. Available in Turkish, English, Italian, Spanish, German and Russian.
releaseNotes: Privacy policy, local data deletion and platform publication preparation.
